en.title: Orzo Soup with Vegetables & Chicken
en.intro: Serve hot with bread or as a main meal.

steps.n1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
steps.n2: Add the chicken cubes and sear with the pepper, mastic and ground cardamom.
steps.n3: Add the chopped onion and stir until it wilts.
steps.n4: Add the peas and carrots and stir together.
steps.n5: Cover the pot and leave the vegetables for 2–3 minutes.
steps.n6: Add the courgette and potatoes and stir.
steps.n7: Add the water or broth and the stock cube and cover.
steps.n8: Cook the vegetables until done but not mushy.
steps.n9: Add the salt and the orzo and cover.
steps.n10: When the soup boils, turn off the heat.
steps.n11: Add the celery and cover for a minute.
